BL-1084 — The Telegram Expedite button commits only half of its promotion: promoteToActive renames paused/ -> active/, but the commit is pathspec-scoped to the destination alone, so the paused/ deletion is never committed and the ticket ends up live in BOTH folders
What it solves: No `required_wiring:` on this ticket, deliberately. The value here is in the CONTENT of a commit, and scenario 01 plus e2e steps 2-3 gate that content end-to-end, so the fix cannot ship green-but-unwired - which is the failure `required_wiring:` exists to catch. Approval context: No judgement call in the fix itself - a rename must be committed as both of its paths or neither, and the commit-integrity CLI already accepts a plural --path list, so the change is small.
